title: France braces for national day of school protests as boy loses hand
summary_full: Thousands expected to join marches of support on Tuesday across the country  amid growing concerns over police response Europe live – latest updatesFrance is bracing for a national day of protests and high-school blockades as a youth protest movement gathers pace amid a growing debate over the scale of the police response. In one incident, a 15-year-old protesting against what demonstrators said were France’s dilapidated ⁠and understaffed ​schools ‌had his hand ‌blown off outside a high school  in the northern town of Lens, said François-Xavier Lauch, the prefect of Pas-de-Calais.
